summary: Our purpose in this project is not limmiting gain information with only image source but also use also musical source. We are doing this with system. We invented the system and created some music. System will analyze a graph and make a noise haves same value with the graphs value. For an example the graph shows 1 value, the system also will make a sound equal that. Also the system reports every second's graph value to consol.
details: Blind Unfold is useful to people that can't see or can't understand the graph or the image. The purposed effect for this project is to see what music could be use for more. We used claude ai for this project for scripting. We believe that our project might be simple but it could be used for important moments. We got attention to creativity, basics and simplity.
